HEVC and H.265 are synonymous, but ED-21 mandates independent identities. This row therefore needs its own unique stage/profile/bit-depth/resolution/workload and its own artifacts/verdict; it may not reuse the preceding row's future result.

Items/Procedure remain internally different: NVENC encoding creates a HEVC bitstream; NVDEC and display consume media through separate engines. A clean displayed reference cannot prove an encoder and a valid bitstream cannot prove pixels.

FFmpeg identifies `libx265` as software and `hevc_nvenc` as NVIDIA hardware with build/GPU/driver-dependent capabilities. The DeepSeek null-output command proves neither hardware selection nor expected output.
